finding: The 379xx whole-wet-article addition/removal contradiction is not established by the 39213 component equation alone.
reason: c_packaging explicitly applies to each separate component; cp_packaging is a component_ledger with independently determined net component mass and composition/source partitions. Neither clause explicitly defines P_open/P_close/W as a full contaminated wet article containing extra separately supplied water/material.

Both waste cards require only discarded component W; a mixed treatment load has one physical total and non-additive composition partitions, so component W is not automatically the entire wet mixed-treatment load.

c_physical separately requires complete gross V/wet-mass and dry-fibre/element reconciliation; c_completeness and v_completeness require actual newly observed exchanges to be individually identified and permit exclusions only for exact same-side OTHER duplicates.

No actual post-receipt wire/HDPE material or water change, wet-component substitution or corrosion/coating recipe is established. The dry-fibre route is not used to assume dry packaging or zero moisture.
bounded_uncertainty: The text says net component mass, not explicitly oven-dry component mass. Concrete data must document component versus attached water/contamination and the gross companion bridge. If an implementation instead puts full contaminated wet mass into component C/W while leaving independently supplied water/material outside that component balance, its scope would need reconciliation; that implementation is not demonstrated here.
action: No additional canonical repair from this lead. Preserve component/gross-account distinction and do not auto-apply the 379xx F/X template. Root may request narrow clarity after independent adjudication.

record.rule: For each physical gate: opening stock + gross external received + paired internal received = closing stock + gross external dispatched + paired internal sent + actual waste + actual emissions. V is this gross physical movement ledger in consistent units; A is the attributed environmental exchange vector and is not V. At the combined gate internal Q transfers cancel; accepted stock remaining in closing FG is never another output added to Q. Reconcile total wet mass and relevant dry fibre/elements independently with actual species/phase evidence. No reaction water is assumed for mechanical fraying.

For each separate component: P_open + I + ER = P_close + S + EO + W. P includes empty/attached-WIP/attached-FG/reusable stock; S follows gross physical shipments rather than net Q; internal reuse cancels. Component receipt with returned product is ER once even if attached. One mixed disposal gets one total treatment provider; source/composition partitions reconcile to that total and do not add providers.

F contains every real newly observed exchange X absent from the current cards; add an atomic row with its own identity/unit/source/protocol before completion. Exclude X from F only for an exact same-side duplicate already itemized in OTHER; document its exact original row. OTHER is not a hiding place for unknown materials or emissions. Preserve all failure/zero-output loads.
